criteria.requirement: Add Interval.affine(scale, offset=0) and translate(offset) for continuous intervals. Positive scales preserve bounds, negative scales swap endpoints and openness, zero maps every nonempty input to a singleton and empty remains empty. Preserve disjoint pieces, infinity direction, Decimal arithmetic and concrete continuous subclasses; reject nonfinite/NaN parameters and explicitly reject AbstractDiscreteInterval images that cannot generally be represented as continuous intervals. Do not change subtraction, replace or apply semantics.
